name: Paradise Island
description: A tropical island resort connected to a colorful nearby town, with beaches, jungle trails, and lively nightlife.

locations.name: Ferry Pier
locations.description: The arrival dock where ferries come and go with visitors, luggage, and local deliveries.

locations.name: Marina Boardwalk
locations.description: A palm-lined waterfront promenade with cafes, charter boats, and sunset views.

locations.name: Resort Lobby
locations.description: An open-air lobby with breezy lounges, concierge desks, and polished stone floors.

locations.name: Beachfront
locations.description: A wide crescent of white sand with umbrellas, volleyball nets, and gentle surf.

locations.name: Infinity Pool
locations.description: A glass-edged pool terrace overlooking the sea, popular for afternoon socializing.

locations.name: Overwater Bungalows
locations.description: Private villas perched above clear water, connected by narrow wooden walkways.

locations.name: Night Market
locations.description: A dense lane of food stalls, handmade crafts, music, and bright lanterns after dark.

locations.name: Old Town Square
locations.description: A historic plaza surrounded by low-rise shops, balconies, and shaded courtyards.

locations.name: Hillside Temple
locations.description: A quiet stone temple on a ridge, reached by worn steps and flowering trees.

locations.name: Jungle Trail
locations.description: A humid path through thick tropical growth, alive with birds and insects.

locations.name: Waterfall Lagoon
locations.description: A secluded freshwater pool fed by a rocky waterfall deep in the island interior.

locations.name: Cliff Lookout
locations.description: A windswept overlook with dramatic ocean panoramas and a steep drop below.
